summary: REAL PASS - The task-n5-full-runtime feature has been successfully implemented. ISH_TASK_ZERO_FULL_RUNTIME flag (set to 1) has been added to ISHRuntimeFlags.h, and TerminalViewController.m now checks this flag before calling task_start(current). When the flag is 0, it records an instrumentation event and returns without starting the guest task; when 1 (current state), it proceeds with task_start(current) enabling full Linux/emulator runtime execution. The implementation maintains clean boundary discipline, follows iOS conventions, includes appropriate comments, and compiles successfully. This completes the Task Zero progression and enables actual guest code execution.
